subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) NJ-OL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ab8e4c2af2ff609196372692a7cda8f64912cf3b138ff816297ca92732c8ab3.png] 

Option 2) **TP-US**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5147f21c5af24c35e4d4268a367954b424dd0e1268890c3ecfa3b03db8160956.png] 

Option 3) QM-RO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c971addcc8d828a7eb65f6269f32c821336a99f37607400d5e73a9805149b3c.png] 

Option 4) KG-LI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b0982ada9dfcf0773af6048a40b7acdeaa66cae82a1e30eba4055acb1caef89.png] 

Here, 'TP-US' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
